339-677-1322-8227.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
339-677-1322-8227.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Loot by sacrificing Jegantha, giving Loot -2/-0 until end of turn
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

3480-4770-5301-6006.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Rin and Seri triggers, creating a 1/1 Dog creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Dog token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2438-7435--5.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature with persist.
When that creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Hardened Academic triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on that creature.
Remove a +1/+1 counter and a -1/-1 counter from that creature as a state-based action.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability from step 1.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5086-5315-6972.description:
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Triskelavus.
When Triskelavus dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability.
Repeat.

511-817-4050-4365-7704.description:
Activate Fungal Bloom by paying {G}{G}, putting two spore counters on a Fungus you control.
Activate a Fungus by removing two spore counters from it, creating two 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing two Saprolings, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat.

4934-5078-7692.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Amareth triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Amareth trigger, causing you to look at the top card of your library, which will be Sensei's Divining Top, and put it into your hand.
Repeat.

49-893-1558-4840.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five untapped Myr.
49-893-1558-4840.description:
Activate Myr Turbine by tapping it and five Myr, searching your library for Myr Battlesphere and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Myr Battlesphere enters, it triggers, creating four 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it, sacrificing Myr Battlesphere and the four Myr tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Soldevi Digger by paying {2}, putting Myr Battlesphere from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Repeat each turn.

uses.exileCardState: with three or fewer time counters on it

80-1618-2440-7373.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures that share a creature type with the tokens generated by Tellah
80-1618-2440-7373.description:
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing all time counters from Venture Forth.
Venture Forth triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Tellah triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the token.
Resolve Venture Forth.
Repeat.
80-1618-2440-7373.notes: You may start the combo controlling fewer that six creatures that share a type with the tokens generated by Tellah. If you do, you need to provide an appropriate amount of mana until Mana Echoes will start generating seven {C} or more.

423-1437-2895-3147.easyPrerequisites: Myojin of Cryptic Dreams has at least two indestructible counters on it.
423-1437-2895-3147.description:
Cast Uro by paying {1}{G}{U}.
Holding priority, activate Myojin of Cryptic Dreams by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the Uro spell three times.
Resolve the first Uro copy.
TThe Uro token enters the battlefield, triggering both of its abilities.
Resolve the first Uro ability, sacrificing it. 
Resolve the other Uro ability, gaining 3 life, drawing a card, and putting Azorius Chancery from your hand onto the battlefield.
Azorius Chancery enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Evolution Sage.
Resolve the Azorius Chancery trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Evolution Sage trigger, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin of Cryptic Dreams.
Repeat from step 3 two additional times.
Repeat from step 2.

2906-4907-5231-6989.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents have lost at least 2 life this turn.
2906-4907-5231-6989.description:
Cast Tatterkite from your graveyard by paying at most {1} due to Rakdos. It won't enter with a finality counter on it due to its static ability.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Tatterkite.
Repeat.

305-4038-5963.description:
Activate Marvin using Llanowar Tribe's ability by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Marvin using Farmstead Gleaner's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Marvin.
Repeat.

1753-2366-3430-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
1753-2366-3430-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G} due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

57-1879-4846-5904.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{U}{R}.
57-1879-4846-5904.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Activate Adric by paying {2}{U} and tapping it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

4910-5657-6489.manaNeeded: {4}{C}{C}{C}{G}{G/U}{G/U}{U} plus enough mana to cast the additional Eldrazi spell
4910-5657-6489.notablePrerequisites: You have another Eldrazi creature card in hand.
4910-5657-6489.description:
Activate Alchemist's Refuge's second ability by paying {G}{U} and tapping it, allowing you to cast spells this turn as though they have flash.
Cast any other Eldrazi except Drowner of Truth by paying its mana cost, triggering Ulalek.
Holding priority, cast Drowner of Truth by paying {4}{C}{G/U}{G/U}.
Drowner of Truth and Ulalek trigger.
Resolve the Ulalek trigger, causing you to pay {C}{C} to copy all spells you control and then copy all activated and triggered abilities you control, ensuring to put Drowner of Truth's trigger on top of Ulalek's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Drowner of Truth's trigger, creating two 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawns by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the copy of Ulalek's trigger, causing you to pay {C}{C} to copy all spells you control and then copy all activated and triggered abilities you control, ensuring to put Drowner of Truth's trigger on top of Ulalek's trigger.
Repeat from step 6.

2051-2541-5646.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
2051-2541-5646.description:
Attempt to draw card, instead choosing to mill 3 cards and return Life from the Loam from your graveyard to your hand.
If you milled a nonland card, The Wise Mothman triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Benthic Biomancer.
Benthic Biomancer triggers, causing you to draw a card and discard Life from the Loam.
Repeat.
2051-2541-5646.notes: The combo fails if you do not mill a nonland card.

77-3967-5145-5466.description:
Cast Rakdos Joins Up by paying {3}{B}{R}.
When Rakdos Joins Up enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Faith Healer by sacrificing Rakdos Joins Up.
Resolve the Rakdos Joins Up ability, returning Archon of Falling Stars from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it.
When Archon of Falling Stars enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Archon of Falling Stars.
Resolve the Archon of Falling Stars ability, returning Rakdos Joins Up from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

880-2692-4871.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
880-2692-4871.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Perilous Forays ability, causing you to search your library for a land card with a basic land type and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Felidar Retreat triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

851-4094-4636-5770.easyPrerequisites: Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.
851-4094-4636-5770.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Architect of the Untamed by paying eight {E}, creating four 6/6 Beast artifact creature tokens.
When the Beasts enter the battlefield, Gonti's Aether Heart triggers four times, causing you to get eight {E}.
Repeat from step 2.

1571-1990-4875-5728.notablePrerequisites: Aspiring Champion does not have summoning sickness, and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
1571-1990-4875-5728.description:
Cast Worldly Tutor by paying {G}, searching your library for Blightsteel Colossus and putting it on top of your library.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Aspiring Champion.
Aspiring Champion triggers, causing you to sacrifice it, then reveal Blightsteel Colossus from the top of your library and put it onto the battlefield as a Demon due to Conspiracy, then causing Blightsteel Colossus to give each opponent eleven poison counters.
Each opponent loses the game as a state-based action due to having ten or more poison counters.

4053-4437.notablePrerequisites: You have the highest life total.
4053-4437.description:
Cast Celestial Convergence by paying {2}{W}{W}, which enters the battlefield with zero omen counters due to Solemnity.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Celestial Convergence triggers, causing you to win the game.

1496-4050-4399-4518.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {1} and either {W} or two life.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
The Soldier enters the battlefield, triggering Verdant Sun's Avatar, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher, causing it to enter the battlefield, triggering itself and Verdant Sun's Avatar.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Verdant Sun's Avatar trigger, causing you to gain three life.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Spirit token, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1306-1458-3459.notablePrerequisites: Battered Golem does not have summoning sickness.
1306-1458-3459.description:
Cast Banishing Knack by paying {U}, targeting Battered Golem.
Activate Mana Crypt by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, returning Mana Crypt from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Mana Crypt by paying {0}.
Mana Crypt enters the battlefield, triggering Battered Golem, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat from step 2.

880-2757-3703.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature, causing you to search your library for a land card with a basic land type and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Sporemound triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the creature token, untapping a basic land.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2178-3126.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one additional Rat.
2178-3126.description:
Activate Marrow-Gnawer by tapping it and sacrificing another Rat.
When the Rat dies, Marrow-Gnawer triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Marrow-Gnawer ability from step 1, creating a number of 1/1 Rat creature tokens equal to the number of Rats you control.
Repeat.

765-1168-1479.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
765-1168-1479.description:
Play Guildless Commons.
When Guildless Commons enters the battlefield, it, Toggo, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Guildless Commons trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Toggo trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Guildless Commons from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Guildless Commons enters the battlefield, it and Toggo trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

2026-3201-3525.notablePrerequisites:
Voyaging Satyr does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Voyaging Satyr.
Arixmethes has at least one slumber counter on it.
2026-3201-3525.description:
Activate Arixmethes by tapping it, adding {U}{G}.
Activate Voyaging Satyr by tapping it, untapping Arixmethes.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Voyaging Satyr.
Repeat any number of times.

364-1987-3277-4792.description:
Activate Paradise Plume by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Paradise Plume and Izzet Chronarch, blinking them as well as triggering Paradise Plume to gain you 1 life.
When Izzet Chronarch enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Paradise Plume enters the battlefield, choose "blue".
Repeat.
